`- OUT: <group> -> IN: <group> - <one-clause reason citing the metrics>`

NEVER pair sectors that have no plausible economic relationship. If no clean pairing exists, instead list them under two plain lines:
`Outflows:` then bullets, and `Inflows:` then bullets.
